input.title: Where should carts live: Redis or Postgres?
input.body:
The 4 KB session cookie truncates long carts. Either option moves the cart server-side and leaves only a cart ID in the cookie.

- **Redis:** fast reads and writes, and key TTLs expire abandoned carts automatically. Carts are ephemeral, so a Redis restart or eviction can lose them unless persistence is configured. Choose it if Redis is already in your stack.
- **Postgres:** durable, transactional, and queryable (abandoned-cart reports, joins to orders and inventory). It needs a cleanup job for old carts. Choose it if Postgres is already your system of record and you don't want another service to run.

Recommendation: Postgres, unless you already run Redis and want TTL expiry for free. It adds no new infrastructure and keeps carts durable.

content.text:
A1 [open] decision: Where should carts live: Redis or Postgres?
actions: a1 resolve "Postgres (recommended)", a2 resolve "Redis"
